heatSettings: HeatSettings[enabled=true, budgetCores=0.25, threads=1, nearStep=1.0, farStep=10.0, naturalReach=32, margin=12, maxSize=48, responseScale=1.0]
thermalTimeScope: simulatedSecondsAcrossJobs and jobs.csv simulated_seconds are thermal seconds after response scaling, excluding natural initialization. gameSecondsAcrossJobs and game_seconds are unscaled elapsed game time. response_scale_at_dispatch is the selected rate, not necessarily the interval-average rate if it changed while a region waited.
snapshotScope: snapshot_prepare_ms is per-tick shared preparation, outside planning_ms but inside thermal_tick_ms. snapshot_slice_ms is one region's batch of at most eight lines/columns. geometry_snapshot_ms, geometry_incremental_ms and material_snapshot_ms sum active slice time for a completed update, excluding time waiting between ticks. Completed updates can overlap capture boundaries. Live preparation targets 2 ms and caps 256 line/column units per tick across all regions; atomic units, allocation, source refresh and scheduling can exceed the soft time target.
invalidationScope: Region invalidations coalesce before snapshots; source changes count prepared source-list changes. Block state pairs count relevant hook events once, capped at 128 distinct pairs plus overflow. No event history is retained outside a capture.
scope: Heat pipeline, including explicitly active local-air diagnostics. thermal_tick_ms contains planning_ms, legacy snapshot_prepare_ms, and local_air_snapshot_advance_ms; these timings overlap and must not be added. local_air_<stage>_wall_ms/cpu_ms/queue_ms require dispatch and collection within this capture; unfinished tail jobs are excluded. local_air_worker_ms is the broader collect-time series and may include jobs dispatched earlier. Legacy worker_* metrics and raw jobs remain legacy-only. This does not measure whole-server MSPT or client FPS.
